Elevator Hitch

A downloadable game for Windows and macOS

Download NowName your own price



Elevator Hitch is a short 2.5D surreal horror/escape room visual novel with point-and-click and puzzle elements following the story of two co-workers suddenly finding themselves stuck together in a "Perfectly Normal" 70s office elevator. 

They must explore each liminal-looking floor and find a way to
get off the elevator to their actual destinations.

◢◤◢◤◢◤◢◤◢◤◢◤◢◤

✄ Development &  Story &  Graphics ✄



> RachelDrawsThis 
> Ekrix

☏ Composer & Sound Designer ☏
> BellKalengar

🗎 Features 🗎
> Original soundtrack
> 60+ CGs and 10+ backgrounds
> 3D map viewing + point-and-click style gameplay
> Character-driven story with lots of dialogue and choices
that effects your entire run
> Infinite suffering by incomprehensible horrors

☢ Estimated Play Time ☢
> 1 hour ~ 1 hour 20 minutes

☠ Number of Endings ☠
> 15
[+ Different dialogue choices/interactions that can be found within the run]

Here's the official puzzle/ending guide 
for anyone who may need it!


☠ Available Translations ☠

KR (Korean) by RachelDrawsThis
zh-CN (Simplified Chinese/Mandarin) by 青灯不弈
ESP (Spanish/Español) by Valentina Zuluaga Lora
pt-BR (Brazilian Portuguese) by Tea Party Project
:: RUS (Russian) by Evil and Debil team


◢◤◢◤◢◤◢◤◢◤◢◤◢◤

NOTICE:
> There is no manual saving in this game.
> TWs include: graphic gore, blood, violence, disturbing imagery and audio, flashing/shaking images and eyestrain, shortly implied family abuse

This was a game completed in a month for submission in SpooktoberVNJam.

All tips and feedbacks are greatly appreciated.

Thank you for visiting and hope you enjoy the game!

This game was absolutely and EXPERIENCE, the art is obviously gorgeous and the first thing that grabbed my attention but everything from the story to the music is solid too.

Even tho I am dumb the puzzles were very fun and the elevator (and rooms) feel really uneasy and, dare I say, liminal.

I played the game a couple of times and got all endings (minus the secret one) and the amount of small details in the game is pretty cool, like all the coworker lines in retrospective, the old room and saving the rat!

My only suggestion would be to maybe consider not locking endings like choosing the wrong (right?) meat to cut locks out of a dead and then you have to replay and it could be mildly annoying not for how amazing this game is, but still something to consider.

Amazing job, keep up the good work!
